verdict.rationale: Grafana is an observability platform, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. First-party docs say AI agents connect through a fully hosted Cloud MCP Server or a self-managed open-source MCP Server, and a probe confirms the official grafana/mcp-grafana repository. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server's use, and detail on the tool coverage it exposes.
